proof_argument: The five explicit affine inverse charts invert their stated matrices exactly; reflection reverses triangle orientation when returning to the source chart. Every recovered coordinate must have a proved exact rational normal form.

Every triangle is nondegenerate, is contained in the source bounds, and lies on one of the source box coordinate planes. Open cells of those planes contain no mesh boundary; winding is constant on each cell.

Rational box inequalities and the four Boolean truth tables independently determine expected membership on each cell. A rational ray in the positive x direction counts signed crossings using only Rational arithmetic. Faces parallel to the ray have zero projected area and do not cross a ray through an open cell.

Projected edge-line intersection with the scaled and translated curve (1/(k+2),1/(k+3)) has a nonzero polynomial of degree at most two. At most 3*T edge lines exclude at most 6*T integer trials; 6*T+1 trials include a nondegenerate ray.

The finite padded grid covers all possible nonzero winding because every output vertex stays inside the source bounds. Matching nonzero winding on every open cell establishes equality of the regularized polyhedral sets including closures.
Independent occupied-cell volumes are summed exactly and compared with the oriented tetrahedral volume. This is additional evidence; same-volume wrong-set controls require a membership rejection.
